note: Small wooded Platte River access south of 200th Street west of Parnell: a short gravel lane into the trees ends at a parking lot with a primitive camping spot beside it. No boat ramp; the river bank is steep. --Claude

flags: INCLUSION: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard, no special-use-permit-only rule, no Rule 101; no brochure on the page. 'This area offers access to the Platte River. There is no boat ramp on this area. Small boats can be loaded by hand into the river, but this is very difficult due to the steep river bank.' Map (11/07): a gravel road from 200th Street ends at the parking lot with the Primitive Camping Area symbol right beside it (about 15 m east). A designated point at the lot, so it stays.
